claim: Your branches appear on the page as a numbered list of up to twenty places.
Each has its name, an address if you've given one, and a link that opens OpenStreetMap at that exact spot.
The map is OpenStreetMap, not Google Maps.
Under the list sits a "Load interactive map" button.
Nothing is fetched from OpenStreetMap until a visitor presses it, and the map that appears frames every place in your list, with a marker only when there is just one.
For each place you type in two numbers, its latitude and longitude, which you can copy from a map app.
If your site runs Privacy Centre and a visitor has turned down functional cookies in its cookie banner, pressing the button shows a short note and no map loads.
The list and its links work for everyone either way.
